_comment: Fridge shelf life in days once stored at 4C, typical Canadian retail cost in CAD. Seeded so the demo is instant and deterministic; anything not here is resolved by the shelf-life agent and cached.

items.name: spinach
items.tip: Keep dry - moisture turns the leaves to slime.

items.name: baby spinach
items.tip: Line the clamshell with paper towel.

items.name: lettuce
items.tip: Store in the crisper, stem end down.

items.name: kale
items.tip: Wrap in a damp towel.

items.name: bell pepper
items.tip: Whole peppers last twice as long as cut ones.

items.name: tomato
items.tip: Flavour is better out of the fridge, life is longer in it.

items.name: cucumber
items.tip: Keep away from the coldest shelf.

items.name: carrot
items.tip: Cut the greens off - they pull moisture out.

items.name: broccoli
items.tip: Loose bag, not sealed.

items.name: cauliflower
items.tip: Store stem down to stop condensation pooling.

items.name: mushroom
items.tip: Paper bag beats plastic every time.

items.name: zucchini
items.tip: Do not wash until you cook it.

items.name: green onion
items.tip: Stand in a glass of water.

items.name: onion
items.tip: Better in a dark cupboard than the fridge.

items.name: garlic
items.tip: Dry and dark, never the fridge.

items.name: potato
items.tip: Cold turns the starch to sugar - use a cupboard.

items.name: avocado
items.tip: Fridge pauses ripening once it yields to a squeeze.

items.name: lemon
items.tip: Sealed bag keeps them from drying out.

items.name: lime
items.tip: Same as lemons - seal them.

items.name: apple
items.tip: Keep apart from greens - the ethylene wilts them.

items.name: banana
items.tip: Counter, not fridge, until they are spotty.

items.name: strawberry
items.tip: Do not wash until you eat them.

items.name: blueberry
items.tip: Sort out the soft ones or they take the box with them.

items.name: grape
items.tip: Keep in the vented bag they came in.

items.name: herbs
items.tip: Stems in water, bag over the top.

items.name: cilantro
items.tip: Stems in water like a bouquet.

items.name: parsley
items.tip: Stems in water like a bouquet.

items.name: milk
items.tip: Back shelf, not the door - the door swings warm.

items.name: yogurt
items.tip: Sealed, back shelf.

items.name: greek yogurt
items.tip: Sealed, back shelf.

items.name: butter
items.tip: Wrapped tight - it takes on other smells.

items.name: cheddar cheese
items.tip: Wax paper, then a loose bag.

items.name: feta cheese
items.tip: Keep it in its brine.

items.name: mozzarella
items.tip: Fresh mozzarella keeps in its liquid.

items.name: cream cheese
items.tip: Sealed tub, back shelf.

items.name: sour cream
items.tip: Store upside down to slow the air in.

items.name: egg
items.tip: In the carton, on a shelf, not the door.

items.name: chicken breast
items.tip: Bottom shelf so nothing drips. Freeze if not cooking in 2 days.

items.name: ground beef
items.tip: Bottom shelf, sealed. Freeze past 2 days.

items.name: bacon
items.tip: Sealed once opened.

items.name: sausage
items.tip: Bottom shelf, sealed.

items.name: deli meat
items.tip: Airtight once the pack is open.

items.name: salmon
items.tip: Coldest shelf, on ice if you can.

items.name: shrimp
items.tip: Coldest shelf, use fast.

items.name: tofu
items.tip: Change the water daily once opened.

items.name: hummus
items.tip: Smooth the top flat to keep air off.

items.name: bread
items.tip: The fridge stales bread - counter or freezer.

items.name: tortilla
items.tip: Sealed bag.

items.name: leftovers
items.tip: Label the container - four days is the limit.

items.name: cooked rice
items.tip: Cool fast, then fridge within an hour.

items.name: orange juice
items.tip: Sealed, back shelf.

items.name: ketchup
items.tip: Door is fine for this one.

items.name: mayonnaise
items.tip: Sealed, clean spoon only.

items.name: salsa
items.tip: Sealed once opened.
